LOOK: Fisherfolk in Cavite and Navotas held a simultaneous “tigil-palaot” protest, seeking massive rollback on fuel products.

Fishers’ group PAMALAKAYA said that at least 50% of fisherfolk at a municipal level have stopped fishing for over a month because they can’t earn nor even recover their fuel cost, which has already increased by around 120% since March.

The fisherfolk also denounced the Marcos administration’s “inadequate” response, especially in the rollout of fuel subsidy that is “insufficient, overdue, and selective”. 

PAMALAKAYA said that prior to the oil price shock, a small fisher in Manila Bay used to spend P560 on diesel per fishing trip. Now that the diesel has reached P124 per liter all-time high, fisherfolk have to prepare P1,240 for 10 liters of diesel, a 121% increase. | RH 15 @JecelleRicafort, DZRH News

📸: @pama_pil
